verdict.rationale: Follow Up Boss is a real estate CRM. Connecting MCP servers is a plausible axis for a SaaS product that might embed an AI assistant, so the story applies. The evidence pack shows only a REST API, webhooks, an llms.txt file and CRM automation features, with nothing on acting as an MCP client or consuming external MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
